title: King Jordon
html:
King Jordon is a named Skeleton seen at level 16 (warrior).

Wearing

head Gold Fullhelmtorso Gold Torsomain hand Gold Longswordoff hand Gold Shield

Where to find King Jordon

  • Inside King Jordon's Tomb · seen 3×

What it can drop

  • Oath of the Dead King (unique Silver Shield, bound): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). +15% damage against undead.
  • Gear every kill: a piece from its tier, excellent or better, and a second piece 1 kill in 5.
  • Gold worth about 5 ordinary kills.
  • Enchanted: 1 kill in 100 enchants a piece (up to 9c, and only what its material can hold).
  • Elite: a boss spawns elite 1 time in 100, and an elite makes its unique 5 times as likely.

From the game’s rules and its own guide. See Unique items.
